title: Chat with Santa Privacy Policy
htmlContent:
Chat with Santa is provided by Scruffy Hipster Ltd. This policy explains local storage, Apple Intelligence, analytics and purchases. Available features depend on your app version, device and system settings.

Names, conversations and Christmas lists

The first name or nickname you enter, conversations, generated replies, saved Christmas wishes and app settings are stored locally in the app. No account registration is required. We do not receive this content on a Scruffy Hipster server. Copies may be included in device backups according to your Apple settings.

Apple Intelligence processing

Chat replies use Apple's Foundation Models. Processing runs on your device, or, on supported systems when available, through Apple's Private Cloud Compute. A Private Cloud Compute request sends the relevant conversation context and the name or nickname used to personalise the reply to Apple for processing. The app falls back to the on-device model when the cloud service is unavailable. Finding Christmas wishes in saved chats runs on your device. Apple explains its processing in its privacy information.

Usage analytics

We use TelemetryDeck to understand app use and improve it. Events describe sessions and return visits, onboarding, feature use, the chosen character, message and reply counts and outcomes, Apple Intelligence availability, and paywall, purchase and restore actions. Events also include technical metadata such as app and operating-system versions, device model, display, language, region, time zone and accessibility settings.

TelemetryDeck uses a hashed, pseudonymous device-based identifier to count distinct users and return visits. We do not add names, message text, wish text, child profile identifiers or conversation identifiers to analytics events. A Santa message event records that a message was sent to Santa, not what it said. See TelemetryDeck's privacy policy.

Purchases and subscriptions

Apple processes payments. We use RevenueCat to check purchase history, manage subscription and Premium access, and restore purchases. RevenueCat receives purchase and entitlement information and an opaque installation identifier stored in the device's Keychain. We do not send RevenueCat a child's name, chats or wishes, and we do not receive payment-card details.

The app gives RevenueCat the already-hashed TelemetryDeck identifier and our TelemetryDeck app identifier so purchase events can be matched to usage analytics. The RevenueCat integration can send purchase and subscription events to TelemetryDeck for that purpose. See RevenueCat's privacy policy.

Sharing and advertising

Sharing a Christmas list uses the iOS share sheet. You choose the recipient or service, and the selected content is then handled by that service. Opening the share sheet is recorded as an analytics action; the list's contents are not sent to our analytics provider. Advertising and voice calling are disabled in version 2.1.0.

Children and local data

A parent or guardian should supervise use, choose a nickname where possible, and avoid entering addresses, school details, contact details or other sensitive information. Purchases and support requests should be handled by an adult. You can delete conversations using the app's available controls or remove its local documents by deleting the app in iOS Settings. Device backups, Keychain identifiers and purchase records are separate from those local documents.

Contact

For privacy questions or requests, contact support@scruffyhipster.com. If you email us, we receive the address and information you choose to include. Please avoid sending a child's private conversation content.
